Method of Attack: dropping malicious payload behind the scenes while installing legitimate software
using cloned websites to deliver malware
hijacking download links on legitimate websites
Discoverer: Doctor Web malware analyst Ivan Korolev
Impacted Systems: Windows systems infected via compromised VSDC installer
computers of victims downloading from cloned nord-vpn.club and other cloned sites
Attack Vector: cloned websites mimicking legitimate sites (e.g., nord-vpn.club mimicking nordvpn.com)
compromised legitimate websites with hijacked download links
malicious payload bundled with legitimate software installers
Indicators of Compromise: valid SSL certificate issued by Let’s Encrypt for nord-vpn.club
GitHub repository by Doctor Web researchers with IoCs for Win32.Bolik.2, Trojan.PWS.Stealer.26645, AZORult, BackDoor.HRDP.32
